Try mid-morning (or mid-afternoon) to beat the crush...
Oct 2019
This place seems to deserve its good reputation, although I worry that it's being 'spoiled' by excessive tourist numbers. At peak times, there are often queues out of the door... and more backpackers than locals cramming the tables. I wasn't able to give the place a try on my last visit - beaten back by the throng!

However, it does seem to have major lulls between the obvious meal times, particularly in the morning. I looked in at about 9.30 one day last week, and found it deserted - the breakfast rush having just passed.

Their trademark Bun Bo Nam Bo - a beef salad with plenty of lukewarm rice noodles, on a bed of lettuce - is certainly very good, and quite a generous portion. But it is priced at 65k - whereas you can get this dish for 35 or 40 from many back-alley vendors (and a not greatly inferior version for 60k from the much less busy, and rather more salubrious little restaurant a couple of doors down). 

They do a few other dishes as well, which might be worth going back to try - although I'm told that when the place is busy, they (not unreasonably) get impatient with people dithering over their order, and you can feel pressured to just go with the bun bo nam bo.
